name: financecheck-ai-naail
description: IFRS® reporting and XBRL™ evidence-review research preview; no IFRS validator, certification, or connected hosted MCP.

interface.longDescription: Educational research preview for IFRS® accounting and XBRL™/iXBRL financial reporting. Current working capabilities are public/synthetic accounting education, deterministic arithmetic and a separate opt-in local SEC US-GAAP XBRL annual-revenue evidence reference. It does not execute IFRS taxonomy validation, ESEF checks or IFRS 18 judgments; no hosted MCP is connected. Not approved or certified by the IFRS Foundation or XBRL International; no audit assurance or investment advice.
defaultPrompt: Explain how IFRS® financial reporting and XBRL™ tagging relate without claiming formal validation.
Outline an ESEF/iXBRL review checklist; distinguish proposed checks from executed tests.
Calculate fictional annual revenue growth and label the evidence limitations.

publication.release_notes: 3.2.1 changes the consumer display name to NAAIL Reporting Inspector, with IFRS/XBRL as a descriptive focus; no new IFRS validator or live MCP.
